author: Johnny Harris
description:
An adventure down the Nile River, looking at how it shaped civilizations, changed the lives of millions, and became the center of one of the world's most important struggles over water.

The Human Element is Johnny Harris' new show. It examines the biggest forces shaping our lives through the lens of the people most affected. 

Watch behind-the-scenes extras to learn how this doc came together. Head to: https://newpress.com/humanelement
